title: ヤマニンゼファー登場！

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The wind blows.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Faintly, fiercely, and calmly. Sharply, silently, and savagely.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The wind blows.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Across the sea, the land, the skies… Maybe even across time itself.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The wind blows.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: From far away, away into the distance—swiftly, ever so swiftly.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: On and on, utterly free.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Will they change positions? Will they change? They changed! She's pulled ahead!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Victory in 1 minute and 35.3 seconds! Your Mile Championship winner is…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (Yes… that's right. I was enchanted by the wind. I yearned for it. And so…)

text_block_list.name: Wind-Like Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much! Everyone's support has been so overwhelming! Truly, it's—huh?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Wh-what do I have to do?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: How can I become like you? How can I become the wind—fierce, free, and ever so fast?

text_block_list.name: Wind-Like Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Oh! You're…

text_block_list.name: Wind-Like Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I see. If you want to make something of yourself, then come.

text_block_list.name: Wind-Like Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Come to Tracen Academy, and join the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Inhale… Exhale.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (The air is still this morning. The dew drops have a silver glimmer, the northwestern clouds a slight thickness.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Let's begin.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hah!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (I was enchanted by the wind. I yearned for it. Then, I found it. And so, I came here.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (Here, starting now, I will run…)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: HYAAAAA!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (…And become the wind!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff… Sigh.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (My legs were light. The earth leapt about, and the scenery flew by.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (And yet…)
Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Morning. You're up early again.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh, good morning, Miracle.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (K.S.Miracle… A classmate akin to a tranquil summer breeze.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: You're up rather early too. The air is still this morning… Has a rushing wind in your heart stirred you to action?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: …A rushing wind? Hehe, maybe.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: I woke up a little earlier than usual, so I thought I'd come for a morning run, only to find you.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Even through the morning mist, I could tell it was you right away. You really do run like the wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Well… you've brought an auspicious updraft with you today. Thank you, Miracle.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: But…

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: …Zephyr?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I'm not there yet. I've still got a long, long way to go…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I must be faster, stronger… I need to hone myself.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I have to… otherwise…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I'll never reach her wind…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The Mile Emperor who enchanted me that day…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I'm still a long way from becoming the gale I aspire to be.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Zephyr…

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: I see. …Yeah, sorry. I wasn't thinking.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh, no, don't worry about it. More importantly… would you like to join me for a run?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The sunlit breeze won't blow for a while yet. Let's kick up some turf, like a squall through the still air of morning.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Really? Sure, I'd love to!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Oh, yeah. Before that—there's one more thing.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: I wanted to congratulate you. Well done, Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: The date of your debut race has been decided, right?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Yes.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I know I've said it before, but… Trainer, I'll be counting on you from here on out.
choice_data_list: Right. Let's do our best, Zephyr!
Right. Let's do our best, Zephyr!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With our sights set on her debut race, Yamanin Zephyr's full-blown training finally begins!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her aim is to become a wind that is strong, swift, and free. And I plan to give her my full support in achieving that goal.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Then, without further ado, please guide me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: It is time for the breeze of a new dawn to blow!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Usually calm and relaxed, Yamanin Zephyr's expression changes once she steps onto the track. And her running is not only precise but incredibly powerful too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Burning with a quiet determination as she prepares for the big race, Yamanin Zephyr steadily masters every facet of her training schedule.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And then…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff… Whew.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh… Already? But I've hardly raised a sigh, let alone a gale.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Each moment of training is like a seed cast by the breeze, no? So how am I to grow if the wind lies still?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I must refine myself further if I hope to raise the wind of my dreams…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr's pure and simple wish to "become the wind" fuels a ferocious motivation in her—and drives her to push on hard.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But that's precisely why I want to help her realize her wish.
choice_data_list: Don't worry. We can pick up from where we left off tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Given that she had to spend time recuperating amidst nature in her youth, I doubt she had an especially strong body to begin with.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On top of that, injuries due to her overeager recklessness cost her several opportunities before I became her trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can't let her fall into that same rut again. Especially not if we're going to make her dream come true.
choice_data_list: No matter what, I'll be the wind at your back.
No matter what, I'll be the wind at your back.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Sorry, Trainer, I… I need to trust you more.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I just now felt the sincere caress of a comforting breeze. Well, if you'll excuse me for today…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Let's do our best tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With our eyes fixed on Yamanin Zephyr's distant dream of becoming the wind, our days of spirited training begin!
